fields.customOptions:
acl kc_host hdr(host) -i REPLACE_ME_PUBLIC_FQDN REPLACE_ME_PUBLIC_FQDN:443
http-request deny unless kc_host
acl kc_admin_path path_beg -i /admin
acl kc_admin_source src REPLACE_ME_ADMIN_IPV6_CIDRS
http-request deny if kc_admin_path !kc_admin_source
acl kc_internal path_beg -i /lb-check /health /metrics
http-request deny if kc_internal
http-request del-header Forwarded
http-request del-header X-Forwarded-For
http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Host
http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Port
http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Proto
http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Prefix
http-request set-header X-Forwarded-For %[src]
http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https
http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Host REPLACE_ME_PUBLIC_FQDN
http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Port 443

instructions: Commissioned on OPNsense 26.7.7 / os-haproxy 5.1 on 2026-10-27: scoped certificate, VIP, firewall, object creation, invalid-config rejection, reload and idempotent reconcile. Exact success responses are in the automatic platform profile. IPv6 server source uses a trailing empty-port colon. Temporary test objects were removed and original settings restored. Revalidate after plugin upgrades.
